scope: Offline production-code capacity model, not mainnet

cases.name: slow-rpc-250ms
cases.limitations: Virtual RPC/block/inclusion timing; real crypto, signing, SQLite and production keeper code. Fake chain execution/receipts and historical beacon; gas, mainnet throughput and monetary accounting are not measured.

limitations: The modeled block interval is 300 ms and transaction inclusion is optimistic at the next block. RPC delays are constant per scenario. Compare with read-only latency evidence; outlier tails, drand outage, real transaction propagation and chain gas throughput remain unmeasured.
